evidence: Touches src/test/util/common.{h,cpp} and updates assertion macros across 15 unit test suites to improve test failure output.
rationale: Improves test failure diagnostics by defining stream output operators for custom types and converting bare `BOOST_CHECK` equality assertions to `BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL`. While useful for debugging failed unit tests, it is internally focused test cleanup that does not fix flaky tests or add high-risk coverage.
